DocuSign for Dynamics 365 (managed solution 'DocuSign', v9.0.2510.1): the docusign_accountconfiguration record's crm_idtoken/crm_accesstoken OAuth session went stale around 2026-02-12 and was never refreshed, causing 'Failed to retrieve Docusign URL for this environment' for every user org-wide (not user-specific — metadata calls like GetCustomActions kept working, only envelope/URL creation broke). Fix requires a System Admin to re-authenticate the DocuSign account in Setup/Admin inside the DocuSign for Dynamics 365 app; not fixable via the Web API.

2026-07-27: raised prvCreateLead depth on role '0 - TYR - Sales Representative' (roleid d4955dab-1c12-f111-8406-7ced8d3cc5ca) from Basic (User) to Local (Business Unit) via AddPrivilegesRole, to fix Caroline Kulp getting 'does not have CreateAccess rights ... entity Lead' when the new Lead's owner defaulted to Joe Eiden (same 'tyr' business unit) instead of herself. Root cause of the owner-defaulting itself wasn't fully confirmed — ruled out plugins, active workflows/business rules, and cascade-assign (doesn't apply at create time); likely a custom Ribbon button or quick-create default-value mapping tied to whatever record she launched 'New Lead' from. This change affects ALL users with that role, not just Caroline.

Dynamics Web API note: to read a role's privilege depths use GET {org}/api/data/v9.2/RetrieveRolePrivilegesRole(RoleId={guid}) (unbound function, not bound to roles(id)). To change one, POST roles({roleid})/Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.AddPrivilegesRole with body {"Privileges":[{"PrivilegeId":"...","Depth":"Local"}]} — Depth must be a quoted enum string (Basic/Local/Deep/Global), not an integer.
